Knew they used people. Did not know they used the people. I believed not asking kept the route cheap and me alive.

Four sealed cases. Two dead drops. No names.
I have a van at the safe site. Registry clears the first scan. After that, we improvise in person.
The ledger carries Morita's live attestation. Preserve the route and I can follow the next handshake upstream.
The same route carries names for every stolen identity. Leave it open and anyone with the cipher can reconstruct them again.
Burn it and Morita disappears behind the organization that paid him. We save today's couriers and guarantee replacements tomorrow.
Preserve it and the people already inside remain inventory. A future rescue does not cancel a present weapon.
V, keep the line open. We trace Morita, copy what we need, then close it from the top.
There is no harmless copy. Erase the index and issue the wipe. Mara keeps her life. The route loses everyone else's.
Keep the line open. Find Morita.
Confirmed. Authenticate the cipher and leave the uplink intact.
Erase the route. Nobody gets the names.
Confirmed. Revoke every package, then destroy the local key.
Decision recorded. Operate the reconstruction core.
Black Lantern is still carrying traffic. Now it carries our shadow with it.
You gave Morrow a map made of people. Make sure he remembers what the symbols mean.
You protected the couriers and destroyed the only clean path upward. Iris calls that mercy. I call it an expensive preference.
Mara remembers one apartment now. Her own. That will have to count as a victory.
The freight yard still treats Pair Seven as an internal failure. No public description, no bounty. Clean work.
Freight security circulated your description. Black Lantern knows the route was attacked, even if it does not know what survived.
People aren't route infrastructure.
No. They were leverage. Our disagreement is whether destroying the leverage removes the hand holding it.
Morita is still out there.
Correct. You changed the route, not the destination. We adapt.
Payment transferred. Keep the channel open. Black Lantern was a route, not the destination.
Should've told you what I knew. Next time I sell confidence, ask what I'm using as collateral.
